name: Ichiu (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Ichiu village emblem in white: an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former village of Ichiu in Tokushima Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-03-01.

features.role: Ichiu village emblem — an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised character
